summary:
Architectural implementation plan for:
1. End-to-end RBAC role persistence from frontend to backend with "Synced to DB" inline feedback, preventing roles from reverting to CLIENT_VIEWER upon reload.
2. Clean, focused Google SSO modal with direct Google OAuth sign-in.
3. Production-grade organization join request approval workflow for Project Managers, Admins, and Owners with both in-app approval banners and SMTP email alerts.
